characters.name: Chef
characters.summary: This evening's reservations seem odd. Never before has Mrs. Mayweather kept company with that scamp from Hudson Lane. Yet, tonight, they have a table for two. Strange.
characters.abilityText: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.

characters.name: Investigator
characters.summary: It is a fine night for a stroll, wouldn't you say, Mister Morozov? Or should I say... BARON Morozov?
characters.abilityText: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.

characters.name: Washerwoman
characters.summary: Bloodstains on a dinner jacket? No, this is cooking sherry. How careless.
characters.abilityText: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk.

characters.name: Librarian
characters.summary: Certainly madam, under normal circumstances, you may borrow the Codex Malificarium from the library vaults. However, you do not seem to be a member.
characters.abilityText: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)

characters.name: Empath
characters.summary: My skin prickles. Something is not right here. I can feel it.
characters.abilityText: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.

characters.name: Fortune Teller
characters.summary: I sense great evil in your soul! But... that could just be your perfume. I am allergic to Elderberry.
characters.abilityText: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.

characters.name: Undertaker
characters.summary: Hmmm....what have we here? The left boot is worn down to the heel, with flint shavings under the tongue. This is the garb of a Military man.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.

characters.name: Monk
characters.summary: 'Tis an ill and deathly wind that blows tonight. Come, my brother, take shelter in the abbey while the storm rages. By my word, or by my life, you will be safe.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.

characters.name: Slayer
characters.summary: Die.
characters.abilityText: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.

characters.name: Soldier
characters.summary: As David said to Goliath, as Theseus said to the Minotaur, as Arjuna said to Bhagadatta... No.
characters.abilityText: You are safe from the Demon.

characters.name: Ravenkeeper
characters.summary: My birds will avenge me! Fly! Fly, my sweet and dutiful pets! To the manor and to the river! To the alleys and to the salons! Fly!
characters.abilityText: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.

characters.name: Mayor
characters.summary: We must put our differences aside, and cease this senseless killing. We are all taxpayers after all. Well, most of us.
characters.abilityText: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.

characters.name: Virgin
characters.summary: I am pure. Let those who are without sin cast themselves down and suffer in my stead. My reputation shall not be stained with your venomous accusations.
characters.abilityText: The 1st time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately.

characters.name: Clockmaker
characters.summary: Do not disturb me. The tick must continue, for the circle is a symbol of life and contains all things - all answers - in its divine machinery. I must work.
characters.abilityText: You start knowing how many steps from the Demon to its nearest Minion.

characters.name: Snake Charmer
characters.summary: Effendi... I am but a humble man, but my pipe is golden and a single tune will tame the wildest djinn, Inshallah. They say that greed hangs more men than rope. But not I, Effendi... not I.
characters.abilityText: Each night, choose an alive player: a chosen Demon swaps characters & alignments with you & is then poisoned.

characters.name: Mathematician
characters.summary: Any consistent formal system x, within which a certain amount of elementary arithmetic can be carried out is incomplete; that is, there are statements of the language of x which can neither be proved nor disproved in x. Ergo, you are drunk.
characters.abilityText: Each night, you learn how many players’ abilities worked abnormally (since dawn) due to another character's ability.

characters.name: Dreamer
characters.summary: I remember the Clockmaker. The sky was red and it was raining fractal triangles. There was a smell of violets and a bubbling sound. A woman with glowing eyes and a scraggly beard was hissing at the sky. Then, I awoke.
characters.abilityText: Each night, choose a player (not yourself or Travellers): you learn 1 good & 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.

characters.name: Flowergirl
characters.summary: Yesterday's violets have withered and died, but today my poppies bloom.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, you learn if a Demon voted today.

characters.name: Town Crier
characters.summary: Hear ye! Hear ye! Witchcraft in the labyrinth! Genius savant reveals all! Town in danger! Hear Ye!
characters.abilityText: Each night*, you learn if a Minion nominated today.

characters.name: Oracle
characters.summary: Only the chosen may gaze beyond the veil. The dead are restless, and they point in silence toward the icy north.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, you learn how many dead players are evil.

characters.name: Savant
characters.summary: Seventy-two matchsticks on the floor... the sun sets early but the moon is unchanged... a torn piece of cloth... evil in the manor house... three by three... the one we trusted is not what he seems... green light means magnesium... residue, but the pattern is wrong... Seventy-two matchsticks on the floor...
characters.abilityText: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn 2 things in private: 1 is true & 1 is false.

characters.name: Seamstress
characters.summary: Did you hear that stranger in the cashmere coat put the word on our young Belle? And she said yes? Well, that's nothing compared to what Harry and that juggler got up to at the fair! The things I could say if I was a tattletale... my, yes.
characters.abilityText: Once per game, at night, choose 2 players (not yourself): you learn if they are the same alignment.

characters.name: Philosopher
characters.summary: If anything is real, beer is real. Drink, for tomorrow we may die.
characters.abilityText: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. If this character is in play, they are drunk.

characters.name: Artist
characters.summary: Mon Dieu! C'est lumineux! My work, she is... how you say... Magnifique! Dieu est révélé! Oui.
characters.abilityText: Once per game, during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.

characters.name: Juggler
characters.summary: For my next trick, as per request, I will need a flower, a bag of beans, a toy snake, a paintbrush, and a motorized gasoline-powered hedge trimming device. I warn you, this trick may be my last. Oh dear.
characters.abilityText: On your 1st day, publicly guess up to 5 players' characters. That night, you learn how many you got correct.

characters.name: Sage
characters.summary: These mountainous tomes guard the secret, I am sure of it! Twixt word and word, it lies in wait. More candles, boy! More ink! These notes may look arcane, but the infernal puzzle is revealing itself.
characters.abilityText: If the Demon kills you, you learn that it is 1 of 2 players.

characters.name: Grandmother
characters.summary: Take a jacket if you go outside, dearie. And your thermos. And your scarf. I have a weak heart, you know. Whatever would I do if you caught cold...or worse?
characters.abilityText: You start knowing a good player & their character. If the Demon kills them, you die too.

characters.name: Sailor
characters.summary: I'll drink any one of yer under the table! You! The chatterbox! Reckon you can take me? No? Howza 'bout you, Grandma? You ever tried Old McKillys Extra Spiced Rum before? Guaranteed to put hairs on yer chest! Step aboard, aye!
characters.abilityText: Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You can't die.

characters.name: Chambermaid
characters.summary: I aint seen nothin' untoward, Milady. Begging your pardon, but if I did see somethin', it certainly weren't the master o' the house sneaking into the professor's laboratory 'round eleven o'clock and mixing up fancy potions, just like you said, Miss.
characters.abilityText: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.

characters.name: Innkeeper
characters.summary: Come inside, fair traveller, and rest your weary bones. Drink and be merry, for the legions of the Dark One shall not harass thee tonight.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, choose 2 players: they can't die tonight, but 1 is drunk until dusk.

characters.name: Gambler
characters.summary: Heads, I win. Tails, you lose.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, choose a player & guess their character: if you guess wrong, you die.

characters.name: Exorcist
characters.summary: We cast you out, every unclean spirit, every satanic power, every onslaught of the infernal adversary, every legion, every diabolical group and sect, in the name and by the power of Our Lord Jesus Christ. We command you, begone and fly far from the Church of God, from the souls made by God in His image and redeemed by the precious blood of the divine Lamb.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are then doesn't wake tonight.

characters.name: Gossip
characters.summary: Blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah. Blah.
characters.abilityText: Each day, you may make a public statement. Tonight, if it was true, a player dies.

characters.name: Courtier
characters.summary: I am more afraid of an army of one hundred sheep led by a lion than an army of one hundred lions led by a sheep.
characters.abilityText: Once per game, at night, choose a character: they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.

characters.name: Professor
characters.summary: The process is simple. Attach the hydraulic confabulator to the modified chi matrix amplifier, add 20 CCs of pseudodorafine, keep his Z levels above 20%, and your husband will be fine. Now, all we need is a lightning strike.
characters.abilityText: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.

characters.name: Minstrel
characters.summary: And I shall hear, tho' soft you tread above me... And all my dreams will warm and sweeter be... If you'll not fail to tell me that you love me... I simply sleep in peace until you come to me.
characters.abilityText: When a Minion dies by execution, all other players (except Travellers) are drunk until dusk tomorrow.

characters.name: Tea Lady
characters.summary: If you are cold, tea will warm you. If you are too heated, tea will cool you. If you are depressed, tea will cheer you. If you are excited, tea will calm you.
characters.abilityText: If both your alive neighbors are good, they can't die.

characters.name: Fool
characters.summary: ...and the King said 'What?! I've never even owned a pair of rubber pantaloons, let alone a custard cannon!' Ho-ho! Jolly day!
characters.abilityText: The 1st time you die, you don't.

characters.name: Pacifist
characters.summary: Distrust all in whom the impulse to punish is powerful.
characters.abilityText: Executed good players might not die.

characters.name: Butler
characters.summary: Yes, sir... No, sir... Certainly, sir.
characters.abilityText: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.

characters.name: Drunk
characters.summary: I’m only a *hic* social drinker, my dear. Admittedly, I am a heavy *burp* socializer.
characters.abilityText: You do not know you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.

characters.name: Recluse
characters.summary: Garn git ya darn grub ya mitts ofma lorn yasee. Grr. Natsy pikkins yonder southwise ye begittin afta ya! Git! Me harvy no so widda licks and demmons no be fightin' hadsup ne'er ma kin. Git, assay!
characters.abilityText: You might register as evil & as a Minion or Demon, even if dead.

characters.name: Saint
characters.summary: Wisdom begets peace. Patience begets wisdom. Fear not, for the time shall come when fear too shall pass. Let us pray, and may the unity of our vision make saints of us all.
characters.abilityText: If you die by execution, your team loses.

characters.name: Sweetheart
characters.summary: I will never forget her. Never.
characters.abilityText: When you die, 1 player is drunk from now on.

characters.name: Klutz
characters.summary: Oops.
characters.abilityText: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player: if they are evil, your team loses.

characters.name: Barber
characters.summary: Did you know that barbery and surgery were once the same profession? No? Well, now you do.
characters.abilityText: If you died today or tonight, the Demon may choose 2 players (not another Demon) to swap characters.

characters.name: Mutant
characters.summary: I am not a freak! I am a human being! Have mercy!
characters.abilityText: If you are “mad” about being an Outsider, you might be executed.

characters.name: Goon
characters.summary: Yes boss. I explained fings real good to dat geezer. He don't want me explain it again. Nah boss, I don't need no doctor - it's only a knife wound. Be right come mornin'
characters.abilityText: Each night, the 1st player to choose you with their ability is drunk until dusk. You become their alignment.

characters.name: Lunatic
characters.summary: I am the night... I think.
characters.abilityText: You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.

characters.name: Tinker
characters.summary: I think I see the problem. Luckily, I have an idea! This catapult will shoot twice as far with just a minor adjustment...
characters.abilityText: You might die at any time.

characters.name: Moonchild
characters.summary: Scorpio looks sideways at the lovers, and you have a choice to make. With silver cross my palm, and your fate shall be revealed. With steel cross my throat, and by the stars you shall regret it.
characters.abilityText: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player. Tonight, if it was a good player, they die.

characters.name: Poisoner
characters.summary: Add compound Alpha to compound Beta... NOT TOO MUCH!
characters.abilityText: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.

characters.name: Spy
characters.summary: Any brewmaster worth their liquor, knows no concoction pours trouble quicker, than one where spies seem double.
characters.abilityText: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.

characters.name: Scarlet Woman
characters.summary: You have shown me the secrets of the Council of the Purple Flame. We have lain together in fire and in lust and in beastly commune, and I am forever your servant. But tonight, my dear, I am your master.
characters.abilityText: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers don't count.)

characters.name: Baron
characters.summary: This town has gone to the dogs, what? Cheap foreign labor... that's the ticket. Stuff them in the mine, I say. A bit of hard work never hurt anyone, and a clip'o'the ears to any brigand who says otherwise. It's all about the bottom line, what?
characters.abilityText: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]

characters.name: Witch
characters.summary: Three drops of goat's blood. A lock of hair, torn in anger. The name is spoken, the shadow cast. Walk left foot first down that brambled path, and don't look back.
characters.abilityText: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.

characters.name: Cerenovus
characters.summary: Reality is merely an opinion. Specifically, my opinion.
characters.abilityText: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are “mad” they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.

characters.name: Pit-Hag
characters.summary: Round about the cauldron go; In the poison'd entrails throw; Toad, that under cold stone; Days and nights has thirty-one; Sweated venom sleeping got; Boil thou first in the charmed pot.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, choose a player & a character they become (if not in play). If a Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.

characters.name: Evil Twin
characters.summary: I'm not Sara! I'm Clara! SHE is Sara! Sara is the evil one! Not me!
characters.abilityText: You & an opposing player know each other. If the good player is executed, evil wins. Good can't win if you both live.

characters.name: Godfather
characters.summary: Normally, it's just business. But when you insult my daughter, you insult me. And when you insult me, you insult my family. You really should be more careful - it would be a shame if you had an unfortunate accident.
characters.abilityText: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. If 1 died today, choose a player tonight: they die. [-1 or +1 Outsider]

characters.name: Devil's Advocate
characters.summary: My client, should the objection be overruled, pleads innocent by virtue of the prosecution's non-observance of statute 27.B - incorrect or misleading conjugation of a verb. The fact that nine of the jury died last night is simply prima facie, which is, as Wills vs Thule set precedent for, further reason to acquit.
characters.abilityText: Each night, choose a living player (different to last night): if executed tomorrow, they don't die.

characters.name: Assassin
characters.abilityText: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die, even if for some reason they could not.

characters.name: Mastermind
characters.summary: The tentacles of that monster are nailed to the doors of the church. Mothers and children are dancing in the street. Excellent. Everything is proceeding exactly as I have planned.
characters.abilityText: If the Demon dies by execution (ending the game), play for 1 more day. If a player is then executed, their team loses.

characters.name: Imp
characters.summary: We must keep our wits sharp and our sword sharper. Evil walks among us, and will stop at nothing to destroy us good, simple folk, bringing our fine town to ruin. Trust no-one. But, if you must trust someone, trust me.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.

characters.name: No Dashii
characters.summary: By the sins of Arnoch, I feel thy laden stench. By the curs-ed sun and her foul legion of tiny grinning gods, I corrupt thee. By the blessed night and the hidden depths of the horrid and unholy sea, I end thy squalid life upon this plane.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Your 2 Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned.

characters.name: Vigormortis
characters.summary: All doors are one door. All keys are one key. All cups are one cup, but whosoever drinketh of the water that I give shall never thirst, but the water shall be in him a well springing up into everlasting life.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbor. [-1 Outsider]

characters.name: Vortox
characters.summary: Black is White. Right is Wrong. Left is Right. Up is Long. Down is Sight. Short is Blind. Follow me. Answers find.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk abilities yield false info. Each day, if no-one is executed, evil wins.

characters.name: Fang Gu
characters.summary: Your walls and your weapons are but smoke in dreams.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st Outsider this kills becomes an evil Fang Gu & you die instead. [+1 Outsider]

characters.name: Pukka
characters.summary: You truly have been kind welcoming me into your beautiful home. I am so sorry I accidentally scratched you. A little thing. No matter. But please, take this golden toothpick as a humble token of my regret.
characters.abilityText: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.

characters.name: Shabaloth
characters.summary: Blarg f'taag nm mataan! No sho gumtha m'sik na yuuu. Fluuuuuuuuurg h-sikkkh.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, choose 2 players: they die. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.

characters.name: Po
characters.summary: Would you like a flower? I'm so lonely.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no-one, choose 3 players tonight.

characters.name: Zombuul
characters.summary: I do not. Understand. Your ways. Fellow human. Show me. The dirt. Where the holy. Lay. Sleeping. I too. Must sleep. Soon.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, if no-one died today, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.

characters.name: Thief
characters.summary: I ain't done nuffink. I weren't even in dat alley last night! It weren't me what stole Mayor Bruno's briefcase wiv all dem fancy dockoments innit. Besides, it was too 'eavy to carry far.
characters.abilityText: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts negatively tomorrow.

characters.name: Bureaucrat
characters.summary: Sign here please. And here. And here. Aaaaaaaaand here. This should all be sorted and tallied by the end of the day, assuming everyone's signatures are legible. We haven't had a mix-up in the paperwork for ages. Yesterday noon, if memory serves...
characters.abilityText: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.

characters.name: Gunslinger
characters.summary: It's time someone took matters into their own hands. That someone... is me.
characters.abilityText: Each day, after the 1st vote has been tallied, you may choose a player that voted: they die.

characters.name: Beggar
characters.summary: Alms for the poor, good Sir? Spare a coin, Madam? Thank you. God bless! You're a right kind soul and no mistake! I'll have some swanky nosh tonight, I will!
characters.abilityText: You must use a vote token to vote. If a dead player gives you theirs, you learn their alignment. You are sober & healthy.

characters.name: Scapegoat
characters.summary: Good evening! Thank you for inviting me to the ball. I'm not from around here, but you sure seem like a friendly bunch, by golly. I'm sure we'll get along just dandy. What's all that rope for?
characters.abilityText: If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.

characters.name: Barista
characters.summary: A cup of coffee with no cream, Monsieur? I’m terribly sorry, but we’re fresh out of cream — how about with no milk?
characters.abilityText: Each night, until dusk, 1) a player becomes sober, healthy & gets true info, or 2) their ability works twice. They learn which.

characters.name: Harlot
characters.summary: Enchanté, Sailor. You look like you need someone to really listen to your troubles. I'm a good listener. Very, very good.
characters.abilityText: Each night*, choose a living player: if they agree, you learn their character, but you both might die.

characters.name: Butcher
characters.summary: It tastes like chicken. More please.
characters.abilityText: Each day, after the 1st execution, you may nominate again.

characters.name: Bone Collector
characters.summary: I collect many things. Hair. Teeth. Clothes. Fragments of poems. The dreams of lost lovers. My secret arts are not for you to know but my fee is a mere pittance. Bring me the blood of a noblewoman who died of heartbreak under a full moon, and you shall have your answers.
characters.abilityText: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: they regain their ability until dusk.

characters.name: Deviant
characters.summary: Twas the lady's quip, forsooth.
characters.abilityText: If you were funny today, you cannot die by exile.

characters.name: Matron
characters.summary: Miss Featherbottom, be quiet. Master Rutherford, a teacup needs just the four fingers, please. I know you are a father of nine, but age, or lack there-of as the case may be, is never an excuse for poor manners.
characters.abilityText: Each day, you may choose up to 3 sets of 2 players to swap seats. Players may not leave their seats to talk in private.

characters.name: Judge
characters.summary: I find the defendant guilty of the crimes of murder, fraud, arson, larceny, impersonating an officer of the law, practicing medicine without a license, slander, regicide, and littering.
characters.abilityText: Once per game, if another player nominated, you may choose to force the current execution to pass or fail.

characters.name: Apprentice
characters.summary: For years have I traveled, studying the ways of The Craft. Which craft, you ask? Simply that of the simple folk. Nothing to worry about. Not yet.
characters.abilityText: On your 1st night, you gain a Townsfolk ability (if good), or a Minion ability (if evil).

characters.name: Bishop
characters.summary: In nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti… Nos mos Dei. Deus vult de nobis.
characters.abilityText: Only the Storyteller can nominate. At least 1 opposing player must be nominated each day.

characters.name: Voudon
characters.summary: Bien venu. Sit down. Breathe deep. Enter the land of the dead. See with their eyes. Speak with their voice. Yon sel lang se janm ase.
characters.abilityText: Only you & the dead can vote. They don't need a vote token to do so. A 50% majority isn't required.
